title: Cohen-Macaulayness is inherited by a slice cut out by a regular element
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that slicing a Cohen-Macaulay morphism by a regular element preserves Cohen-Macaulayness. The proof reduces to the local statement about a ring map and an element that is a nonzerodivisor on the fibres, and then uses the dimension formula for the slice together with depth considerations to transfer the Cohen-Macaulay property. The transfer of depth across the slicing element is the step that carries the content. Retained author proof at lines 6378-6434.
